Name: Animal Queue -Young Animals Follow Adults
Description:
A farm can offer more than production efficiency. A line of youngsters following an adult, [color=#00ff00]a few breaking away for a quick circular run[/color], then returning to the group: 
[color=#ffff00][size=5]This mod aims to add small, visible moments between daily chores.[/size][/color]

The focus: [color=#00ff00]make animals feel connected, and make the chick stage something you can choose to keep.[/color]
[color=#ff00ff]Following and playful running[/color] bring activity to the farm. The optional growth and egg settings let players who enjoy the chick appearance retain it without giving up egg production. Both options are off by default.

[color=#ff7700]Chicks, ducklings, lambs and other juvenile farm animals follow reachable adults[/color] of their own kind in the same location. Each youngster follows a position along its adult leader's recent route independently.

[color=#00ff00]Following and daily life[/color]
• Indoor [color=#ffff00]following[/color] and balanced assignment between suitable adults are enabled by default.
• Routes [color=#ffff00]respect obstacles and reachable areas[/color]. Youngsters do not follow leaders through closed fences or across maps.
• Default spacing is about one tile. Following stops at 17:00 so normal homecoming can take over.
• [color=#ffff00]Following youngsters receive normal-grass feeding by default [/color]without consuming map grass. The daily benefit is not repeatedly awarded.
• Animals without a suitable adult retain their ordinary activities. Assignments are reconsidered when animals or reachable routes change.

[color=#00ff00]Circle running[/color]
Youngsters from any queue position can briefly leave, [color=#ff00ff]run along a real circular path and rejoin their leader.[/color] Defaults: 20% chance per attempt, up to three simultaneous runners per queue, a 0.75-tile radius, one to three laps, 240 pixels per second, and at least 20 seconds of cooldown after completion.
Enough space is required; probability and cooldown affect how many animals participate. Adult idle turning has a separate switch.

[color=#00ff00]Optional chick settings[/color]
KeepChicksYoung, off by default, pauses juvenile growth for White, Brown, Blue, Void and Golden Chickens. [color=#00ff00]Turning it off resumes growth; adults are never turned back into chicks.[/color]
ChicksLayEggs, off by default, removes the juvenile egg-production restriction for those chicken types while retaining normal feeding, mood, [color=#00ff00]production intervals and collection rules.[/color]
The two options are independent and [color=#00ff00]do not change duckling or other animal growth.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]Installation and settings[/color]
Requires SMAPI. Extract AnimalQueue into Mods and launch through SMAPI once to generate config.json.
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Its main configuration page includes Reset to Default. Configuration labels are currently in Chinese; the JSON property names are in English. You can edit config.json with the game closed or reload it with animal_queue_reload in the SMAPI console.

[color=#D4D4D8]农场不必只有生产效率。小动物跟着成年领队走一段路，几只幼崽突然离队跑圈，再回到队伍里——这个模组希望让[/color][color=#00ff00]照料动物之外，也有一些有趣的画面可看。[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]核心体验：让动物之间看起来有联系，让幼崽不只是很快过去的成长阶段。[/color]
[color=#ff00ff]跟随与跑圈[/color][color=#d4d4d8]负责增加生活感；“不成长”和“幼年产蛋”则让喜欢小鸡外观的玩家可以自行选择保留幼年状态，同时维持产蛋用途。两个选项默认关闭。[/color]

[color=#ff7700]小鸡、小鸭、小羊等幼年农场动物会寻找同一地点内可到达的同类成年动物，各自靠近成年领队行走路线上的队列位置[/color][color=#d4d4d8]。每只幼崽独立移动，不需要等待前一只幼崽。[/color]

[color=#00ff00]跟随与生活[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]• 默认在农场及动物舍内[/color][color=#ffff00]跟随[/color][color=#d4d4d8]，并尽量平均分配同类成年领队所带的幼崽。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]• 路线会检查障碍和可达区域，不跨地图追赶，也不会隔着关闭的围栏选择领队。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]• 默认间距约 1 格，17:00 停止跟随，交给游戏处理回舍。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]• 跟随中的[/color][color=#ffff00]幼崽默认获得普通青草的饱食效果[/color][color=#d4d4d8]，不消耗地图青草；每日补给不会重复叠加。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]• 无合适成年领队时保留原有活动。成年领队、幼崽增减或通路变化后会重新检查分配。[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]离队跑圈[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]队内任意位置的幼崽都可能暂时离队，[/color][color=#00ff00]沿圆形路线实际跑动[/color][color=#d4d4d8]，然后重新跟随。默认每次尝试触发概率 20%，每队同时最多 3 只，半径 0.75 格，每次 1～3 圈，速度 240 像素/秒，动作完成后至少冷却 20 秒。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]跑圈需要足够空间，概率和冷却也会影响实际参与数量。成年动物的闲暇原地转向有独立开关。[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]幼年鸡选项[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]KeepChicksYoung：幼年鸡不成长，默认关闭。[/color][color=#00ff00]关闭后从当前年龄继续成长，不会把成年鸡变小[/color][color=#d4d4d8]。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]ChicksLayEggs：[/color][color=#00ff00]幼年鸡也能产蛋[/color][color=#d4d4d8]，默认关闭。仍遵循原版喂养、心情、周期和收取方式。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]两个开关独立，适用于白鸡、棕鸡、蓝鸡、虚空鸡和金鸡，不改变鸭等其他动物的成长规则。[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]安装与配置[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]需要 SMAPI。将 AnimalQueue 文件夹放入 Mods，使用 SMAPI 启动一次，即会生成默认 config.json。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]可选安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，修改配置并使用首页底部“重置为默认”按钮。当前配置菜单标签为中文。也可退出游戏编辑 config.json，或使用控制台命令 animal_queue_reload 重新读取配置。[/color]
